subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Out of every hospital in Ohio on Medicare's list, every kind counted.
Small rural hospitals with 25 inpatient beds at most, paid by Medicare on their costs.
By the county each hospital sits in, as CMS records it.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: What percent of the hospitals in Ohio belong to Bon Secours Mercy Health?
questions.why: 18 of 196. The next biggest system there, Cleveland Clinic, has 16.

questions.q: How many of Bon Secours Mercy Health's hospitals are critical access hospitals?
questions.why: They are Marcum and Wallace Memorial Hospital, Mercy Allen Hospital, Mercy Health - Urbana Hospital, Mercy Health - Willard Hospital and Rappahannock General Hospital.

questions.q: How many of Bon Secours Mercy Health's hospitals are outside a metropolitan area?
questions.why: They are Bon Secours Southern Virginia Medical Center, Marcum and Wallace Memorial Hospital, Mercy Health - Defiance Hospital, Mercy Health - Lourdes Hospital, Mercy Health - Tiffin Hospital, Mercy Health - Urbana Hospital, Mercy Health - Willard Hospital and Rappahannock General Hospital.

questions.q: How many beds do Bon Secours Mercy Health's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From 27 of the 35 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024; the others had no full year on file.

questions.q: How many beds does Bon Secours Mercy Health's biggest hospital report to Medicare?
questions.why: It is Mercy St. Vincent Medical Center. St. Elizabeth Youngstown Hospital is next, with 341.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds do Bon Secours Mercy Health's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: That is 16 percent of their 4,052 beds. From 27 of the 35 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024; the others had no full year on file.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Bon Secours Mercy Health's hospitals report in a year, added together?
questions.why: About 650 a day. From 27 of the 35 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024; the others had no full year on file.
